title: The canonical localized chart tuple is compatible
statement: Let $R,S$ be commutative rings, $\varphi:R\to S$ a ring map, $f:\operatorname{Fin}(t)\to R$, and $X=(M',M_j,\alpha_j,\alpha_{jk})$ a formal glueing datum [def-weil-pbc-formal-glueing-data]. Fix $i:\operatorname{Fin}(t)$ and $x\in M_i$. Put $u=f_i$ and $A=M'\times\prod_j M_j$, with all modules viewed over $R$. Let $\ell:A\to (M')_u\times\prod_j(M_j)_u$ be the coordinatewise localization map [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away]. Let $e$ be the unique comparison isomorphism from that finite product to $A_u$ commuting with the localization maps. Set $z=e(\alpha_i^{-1}(1\otimes x),(\alpha_{ij}(x/1))_j)$. For each $j$ define $a_j:A\to S\otimes_R M_j$ by $a_j(m',(m_k))=\alpha_j(m'/1)-1\otimes m_j$. For each $j,k$ define $b_{jk}:A\to(M_k)_{f_j}$ by $b_{jk}(m',(m_l))=\alpha_{jk}(m_j/1)-m_k/1$. Then $(a_j)_u(z)=0$ for every $j$ and $(b_{jk})_u(z)=0$ for every $j,k$.

source.place: Remark 05EL; Lemmas 05EQ and 05EP, used in Proposition 05ER, second paragraph (verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/05ER and the linked tags 05EL, 05EQ, 05EP).

proof.text: Construct exactly the specified tuple using localization of the finite product. Its prime and chart coordinates are the displayed ones; no choice of an undetermined object occurs. The comparison is the unique linear equivalence commuting with the localization maps. Zero parameters give zero localizations.

source.place: Lemma 05EP (lemma-equivalence-I-unit), proof: after a generator becomes a unit one component recovers the others; Remark 05EL, cocycle condition (b)

proof.text: The tuple $e(x)$ satisfies the equations defining H^0 after localization at u. For the $j$th equation, localize condition (a) of [def-weil-pbc-formal-glueing-data] at $u=f_i$ and evaluate it on $y'/1\in((M')_{f_i})_{f_j}$. Its left side, $(\alpha_{ij}\otimes_RS)c^{M_i}_{f_j}(\alpha_i)_{f_j}(y'/1)$, is $\alpha_{ij}(x/1)\otimes1=y_j\otimes1$; its right side, $c^{M_j}_{f_i}(\alpha_j)_{f_i}\sigma^{M'}_{f_i,f_j}(y'/1)$, is the image of $\alpha_j(y')$ under the tensor-localization identification. Hence the $j$th localized equation holds [lem-weil-pbc-formal-glueing-canonical-maps] (2), (3). For the $(j,k)$th equation, evaluate condition (b) on $(x/1)/1$ in $((M_i)_{f_j})_{f_k}$ and localize at $u$: its left side is $\alpha_{jk}(y_j/1)$ and its right side is $y_k/1$ after the swaps $\sigma$ identify the iterated localizations [lem-weil-pbc-formal-glueing-canonical-maps] (2). The resulting tuple is compatible in the localized ambient product.

lean.statement:
theorem localized_chart_tuple_compatible {t : ℕ} (φ : R →+* S)
    (f : Fin t → R) (X : Data.{u, v, w} φ f) (i : Fin t)
    (x : piece (f i) (X.M i)) :
    letI : Algebra R S := φ.toAlgebra
    let A := ModuleCat.of R (restrict φ X.M' × ∀ j : Fin t, piece (f j) (X.M j))
    let p : ∀ j : Fin t, A →ₗ[R] piece (f j) (X.M j) :=
      fun j ↦ (LinearMap.proj j).comp (LinearMap.snd R _ _)
    let a := fun j : Fin t ↦
      (((X.alpha j).toLinearMap.comp
        (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap _ (restrict φ X.M'))).comp
          (LinearMap.fst R _ _) -
        (TensorProduct.mk R S (piece (f j) (X.M j)) 1).comp (p j))
    let b := fun j k : Fin t ↦
      (((X.alpha_overlap j k).toLinearMap.comp
        (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap _ (piece (f j) (X.M j)))).comp (p j) -
        (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap _ (piece (f k) (X.M k))).comp (p k))
    let T := Submonoid.powers (f i)
    let ell₀ := LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap T (restrict φ X.M')
    let ell₁ : (∀ j, piece (f j) (X.M j)) →ₗ[R]
        (∀ j, LocalizedModule T (piece (f j) (X.M j))) :=
      LinearMap.pi fun j ↦ (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap T _).comp (LinearMap.proj j)
    let e := IsLocalizedModule.linearEquiv T (ell₀.prodMap ell₁)
      (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap T A)
    let z := e ((X.alpha i).symm (TensorProduct.tmul R (1 : S) x),
      fun j ↦ X.alpha_overlap i j (LocalizedModule.mk x 1))
    (∀ j, localMap (f i) (a j) z = 0) ∧
      (∀ j k, localMap (f i) (b j k) z = 0)
